home.title: Max Guerois — Builder, Thinker
home.description: Max Guerois — 29-year-old repeat founder based in Paris. Co-founded Lucis, a preventive health startup backed by YC and General Catalyst, operating across France, UK, Ireland and Portugal. Biological age 9.7 years younger, aging 26% slower than average. Open protocols on longevity, testosterone, and sleep.
home.ogDescription: 29-year-old repeat founder based in Paris. Co-founded Lucis, a preventive health startup backed by YC and General Catalyst, operating across France, UK, Ireland and Portugal. Biological age -9.7 yrs.
home.name: Max (Maxime) Guerois
home.headline: My blood says I'm 19. Here's how.
home.intro: I'm Max. I'm 29, and my biological age is 19. I previously founded Lucis, Europe's most comprehensive blood testing platform, and grew it from 0 to seven-figure revenue. Now I'm building the most measured version of myself. This site is the protocol.
home.askAiPrompt: Dig into my health protocol, founder story, or longevity obsession.
home.lucisDesc: Preventive health startup backed by General Catalyst and Y Combinator. Helped build the brand, positioning, and early traction across Europe.
home.zeroClubDesc: 50K+ members across 20+ countries — Europe's longevity community. Built to find the people obsessed with health optimization. It grew so fast it became Lucis.
home.theArchDesc: Where Web3 founders, operators & talent found each other — across 20+ countries. Proved I could build community at scale. Then I realized health was the community I actually wanted to build.
home.practupDesc: Fitness app to sync your health data and find workout buddies — 50k+ users in France. My first instinct that health & community belonged together.

experiments.title: Experiments — Max Guerois
experiments.description: Health experiments, protocols, and biomarker tracking by Max Guerois. Sleep, testosterone, longevity.
experiments.heading: What I'm tracking and learning
experiments.intro: I run experiments on myself — sleep, hormones, biomarkers — and publish the data. Everything here is honest, sourced, and updated as I learn more.

experimentsMeta.sleepTagline: 3 months of tracking with the Ultrahuman Ring Air. Took my sleep score from 82 to 100 in 15 days. 7 changes that actually moved the needle.
experimentsMeta.testosteroneTagline: Nothing besides TRT will drastically increase levels. The key is lifestyle. 31 science-backed actions, organized into morning ritual, evening ritual, diet, training, and stress management.
experimentsMeta.biomarkersTagline: Metabolism, hormones, body composition, strength, and biological age. −9.7 years biological age vs. chronological. Pace of aging: 0.74.
experimentsMeta.supplementsTagline: 11 supplements tied to my bloodwork. Three systems were broken: hormones, thyroid, inflammation. Full stack with doses, timing, and products.
